create_Voxelizer_with_augmentation: create a Voxelizer instance with voxel size, clip bounds, and data augmentation settings enabled
run_Voxelizer_voxelize: run voxelize on point cloud coordinates, features, and labels to produce sparse voxel grid output
run_Voxelizer_voxelize_temporal: run voxelize_temporal on a sequence of point clouds sharing a single transformation matrix
test_Voxelizer_clip: test the clip method to filter point cloud coordinates within a specified bounding box
review_Voxelizer_get_transformation_matr: review get_transformation_matrix to understand how rotation and scale augmentation matrices are computed
